answer: An identity's epoch quill is valid only when willows of three distinct branches co-sign it, each locking at least the floor that the quill's hash-chosen home wharf tallies as its heaviest lock ever held. Clones hash to branches too, so one operator's k fakes lift those wharves' floors: its k-th clone needs every willow locking about base×2^(k/P), forfeited whole when the fake is judged — capital burned per head, unbought elsewhere. A newcomer meets the first, cheapest floor.
